summary: This is a client‑side WebGL/Three.js tool that lets users assemble a PC model in the browser. It runs as a pure web UI without any backend API or package distribution. It is suited for developers or hobbyists wanting an interactive 3D PC builder demo. The standout strength is its unique focus on PC assembly, while the main caveat is the lack of community support and integration options, as reflected by only 8 Hacker News points and no API.
